featured_reviews.name: Rahul Ubale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here’s some valuable feedback on *catering (for customer experience, food, and service)*:

1. *Presentation matters* – Even with great taste, food should look appealing. Use clean, elegant plating and garnish thoughtfully.
2. *Timeliness is key* – Ensure food arrives hot and on time. Delays can ruin even the best menu.
4. *Taste consistency* – Keep flavors balanced and consistent across all servings.
5. *Staff behavior* – Polite, attentive staff make a huge difference in customer satisfaction.
6. *Hygiene* – Maintain top-notch cleanliness in prep, serving, and staff appearance.

featured_reviews.name: rajesh mahatme
featured_reviews.review_text:
Srinivasan Caterers!
If anyone is looking for authentic South Indian cuisine for weddings or any grand functions, this is the name I would wholeheartedly recommend.

We were fortunate to have Srinivasan and his wonderful team cater for both the engagement and the wedding of my daughter, Grishma, with Nikhilesh. My first experience of his exceptional food was during the engagement ceremony in Goa in 2024. The quality, taste, and service left such a lasting impression that there was no second thought—we had to have Srinivasan cater the wedding as well.

So impressed were we that we went all out and even took on the administration at NESCO, Goregaon, breaking their catering monopoly to induct Srinivasan and his team for the wedding in January 2026. We willingly paid the additional royalty, simply so our guests could enjoy his outstanding cuisine. And what a decision that was!

From breakfast to lunch and dinner, every meal was a delight. Guests literally went bonkers over the food. Several attendees—some of them well-known South Indian caterers themselves—personally came up to praise the authenticity, taste, and flawless execution.

The sheer scale and variety of the menu was astonishing. One wonders how Srinivasan and his team manage such extensive preparations with such consistency and finesse, especially at this magnitude.

I strongly recommend Srinivasan Caterers to anyone and everyone who wishes to truly please their guests at any private function. Hire him without a second thought—you will definitely not regret it.

featured_reviews.name: Saketan Anand
featured_reviews.review_text: Srinivasan and Sabari were in charge of catering for my wedding this year - they did an incredible job serving 6 different meals. The service was perfect - always anticipating guests needs and servicing any and all requests. All different flavors and all exceptional. They made some of the most innovative dishes in TamBrahm food that I have tasted and all tasted delicious - from chakkai elai adai to ulundu vadai to pineapple payasam and arbi roast - this was an unforgettable experience for all the guests. Highly highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Priya Vishwanath
featured_reviews.review_text: The most professional, efficient and humble vendor I have ever associated with. He catered all my wedding and pre wedding functions and the food was scrumptious. The best part is the positivity, creativity and perfection that he gets to the table. There is not even one request that he did not honour. Right from arranging for my jadai from Chennai itself ,  display of dolls to give South Indian touch , beautifully decorated oonjal and designer menu cards for all guests , he ensured that the experience is memorable for all guests and honourable for my parents.

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Srinivasan Caterers did a phenomenal job providing catering and marriage contracting for my South Indian wedding in Mumbai at Chembur Fine Arts. The food served was delicious while authentic and traditional. The decorations and arrangements were exquisite and gorgeous. Srinivasan and his staff were courteous and very accommodating. They took care of all of the details no matter how big or small and really alleviated some of our wedding stress. The kolams, the poojas, the parppu thengai, bakshanams, dry fruit decorations were all done perfectly as per traditions. Very well well-versed with all the south indian iyer marriage customs. We looked to him for guidance.
Definitely recommend them for any of your functions! We have already recommended him to alot of our family members as they were impressed with his work.

Everything was precisely delivered to plan: the pooja arrangements, kolams, the breakfast, lunch arrangements – everything was perfect to the ‘T’.   You and your team executed beyond our expectations.  All guests complimented the top notch food and we have personally recommended your services to many of them. We sincerely wish that your business grows exponentially. We look forward to working with you and your team again in the future.
